integrity: Mathematical proof and reproducible finite checks provided. The checks supplement but do not replace the proof; novelty is assessed against accessible sources and remains subject to independent scrutiny.
scientific_limitations: Global optimization of the entrance rate is classified only for two coupon types.
For three or more types the sparse distribution gives an asymptotic competitor, not the full optimum.
Stationary entrance frequency differs from expected first completion time after an empty start.
Sampling is independent and identical through time, with a deterministic fixed-length expiration window.
Historical run-pattern optimization could imply an equivalent form and warrants independent priority verification.
title: Symmetry breaking in stationary entry rates of expiring coupon collectors
